gap: No result ChatGPT got states that UGREEN's US store sold the 4-bay NASync DH4300 Plus for $373.99 on 2026-11-17, less than its 2-bay DXP2800 at $389.99, or that the 2-bay DH2300 was $239.99 and the DXP4800 Plus it showed as a card was $619.99.
standout_why: ChatGPT's saved chat lists no search results and no cited pages. Its only content is two catalog cards (Synology DS224+, UGREEN NASync DXP4800 Plus) with no prices and a question about capacity. So no rival page gave any price. That makes today's maker-store prices new, but I could only price the UGREEN models. I couldn't price the drives-included models (BeeStation, BeeStation Plus, Buffalo LinkStation 720D), so the finding doesn't settle the 'drives included' pick that our page title promises.
decides: It confirms DH2300 ($239.99) as the low-cost UGREEN entry. It shows the DH4300 Plus (4 bays, $373.99) costs less than the DXP2800 (2 bays, $389.99) today, so the DXP2800 loses on price per bay for a shopper who doesn't need its Intel CPU. It also prices ChatGPT's DXP4800 Plus card at $619.99, which is $246 more than the DH4300 Plus. It doesn't decide the pick between the drives-included BeeStation and the bring-your-own-drives UGREEN models, because no Synology or Buffalo price could be read today.
